name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
While you were gathering the supplies, I had some of my people handle marking the Scourge buildings we need demolished.

Here's the plan: I'm going to give you ten sticks of my special compound. You're going to take them over to Plaguewood and plant them inside the Scourge structures that I've had marked for detonation.

<Smokey snaps his fingers.>

Bing! It's just that easy.
narrative.objectives:
Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.

Once you plant the bomb, leave the building and marvel at your handiwork.

By the way, Smokey's Special Compound is rather... unstable.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You're much darker than I remember. You got that look going for you; the look that says, 'I've been charred by a high explosive bomb.'

<Smokey laughs.>

Anyhow! Here's your cut of the loot. I've thrown in a little something extra to help soothe the burns.
narrative.requestItemsText: I got supplies left over to make a few more sticks of the special compound. Just let ol' Smokey know if you need more.

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 58, 12,400 XP in all.

quests.name: That's Asking A Lot
quests.objectiveText: Smokey LaRue wants you to get 2 Thorium Bars, 1 Golden Rod, 8 Hi-Explosive Bombs, and 8 Unstable Triggers. You will have to find a blacksmith and an engineer for these items.

quests.name: When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope.
